title: Resilient Applications and APIs

header.html: Create and maintain fault-tolerant, resilient applications with retry and backoff and graceful degradation (1.1.3); create, extend and maintain APIs, including request and response transformations and validation (1.1.4)
the official AWS Developer Associate (DVA-C03) exam guide, Task 1.1

html:
1Resilience techniques

Technique What it does
Retry with exponential backoff Wait longer after each failure (1 s, 2 s, 4 s ...) so you do not flood a struggling service
Jitter Add random delay so many clients do not retry at the same moment
Timeouts Stop waiting after a set time so threads and connections are not held forever
Idempotency A repeated request has the same effect as one request, so retries are safe
Graceful degradation Keep core features working and drop optional ones (show cached data) when a dependency fails
Dead-letter queues Park work that keeps failing instead of losing it or retrying forever
Circuit breaker Stop calling a failing dependency for a while, then test it again

Exam tip

. Throttled or 5xx response = retry with exponential backoff and jitter. The AWS SDKs retry automatically with backoff; do not write an immediate retry loop.

429 Too Many Requests and throttling errors are retryable; 4xx validation errors are not (fix the request).

2Amazon API Gateway

API type Use
REST API Full features: request validation, usage plans and API keys, caching, mapping templates
HTTP API Cheaper and faster, simpler features, JWT authorizers
WebSocket API Two-way, real-time connections

Integration types (REST API)

Type Meaning
Lambda proxy The whole request goes to Lambda; Lambda returns the whole response
Lambda (custom, non-proxy) API Gateway maps the request and response with mapping templates
HTTP / AWS service Call another HTTP endpoint or an AWS API directly
Mock API Gateway answers itself, with no backend

Shaping and protecting requests

Feature Purpose
Request validation Check required parameters and body schema before the backend runs; rejects with 400
Mapping templates (Velocity Template Language) Transform request and response data
Throttling and usage plans Limit requests per second and quotas per API key
Caching Cache responses per stage for a TTL
CORS Allow browsers on other origins to call the API
Exam tip

. "Reject bad input before it reaches Lambda" = API Gateway request validation. "Change the shape of the request or response" = mapping template (non-proxy integration).

Exam tip

. 4xx validation errors are not retried unchanged; 429 and 5xx are retried with backoff.

3Exam Q&A

3.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A client receives throttling errors from a service during a traffic spike. What is the best client behavior?

  • ARetry immediately in a tight loop
  • BStop forever after the first error
  • CIncrease the request rate
  • DRetry with exponential backoff and jitter
Show the answer

Answer: D. Backoff with jitter reduces load and avoids synchronized retries.

S2A retried request charged a customer twice. Which design property was missing?

  • AIdempotency
  • BLong polling
  • CCaching
  • DFan-out
Show the answer

Answer: A. An idempotent operation has the same effect when repeated.

S3A shop shows recommendations from a service that is down. What is the best graceful degradation?

  • AReturn an error page for the whole site until the service recovers
  • BRetry the recommendation service for ten minutes before showing anything
  • CShow the page without recommendations or with cached ones
  • DRestart the web servers every time the recommendation service fails
Show the answer

Answer: C. Keep core features working and drop the optional one.

S4A team wants API Gateway to reject requests with a missing field before invoking Lambda. What should they use?

  • AA mapping template that rewrites the request body
  • BRequest validation with a model
  • CA usage plan with a low request quota per API key
  • DA stage variable that stores the field names
Show the answer

Answer: B. Request validation checks the body schema and returns 400 early.

S5A developer wants to change the JSON shape of a request before it reaches a backend, and the integration is not proxy. What fits?

  • AA dead-letter queue
  • BA usage plan
  • CCORS
  • DA mapping template
Show the answer

Answer: D. Mapping templates transform the request and response in non-proxy integrations.

S6Which API Gateway API type supports two-way real-time communication?

  • AREST API
  • BHTTP API
  • CWebSocket API
  • DMock integration
Show the answer

Answer: C. WebSocket APIs keep a two-way connection open.

3.2 Recall questions

R1What does jitter add to a retry?

Show the answer

A random delay, so clients do not retry at the same moment.

R2What is idempotency?

Show the answer

Repeating a request has the same effect as running it once.

R3What does a circuit breaker do?

Show the answer

Stops calling a failing dependency for a while, then tests again.

R4Which API Gateway integration returns a response without any backend?

Show the answer

Mock integration.

R5What feature limits requests per API key?

Show the answer

Usage plans with throttling and quotas.

R6Which HTTP error class should not be retried unchanged?

Show the answer

4xx validation errors (except throttling, 429).

4Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Retries exponential backoff + jitter; SDKs do this; timeouts; idempotency
Degradation keep core, drop optional; DLQ; circuit breaker
API types REST (full), HTTP (cheap), WebSocket (real-time)
Integrations Lambda proxy, non-proxy with mapping templates, HTTP/AWS service, mock
Protect request validation, throttling and usage plans, caching
